mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, customer_name AS customerName, postal_code AS postalCode, adress AS address, phone_number AS phoneNumber, total_amount AS totalAmount, order_at AS orderAt FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, customer_name, postal_code, adress, phone_number, total_amount, order_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{customerName}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderAt} )
